tickets.title: Prepare mortgage liquidity source analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a mortgage liquidity source analysis comparing bank cash, short-term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales, and vested employer shares to fund the remaining down payment while preserving the stated reserve target.

tickets.title: Obtain underwriting asset documentation
tickets.text: Obtain underwriting asset documentation tying the earnest money withdrawal to the source account, as the underwriter is asking for documentation linking the $25,000 earnest money withdrawal to the source account.

tickets.title: Review cash-flow effect of rate-lock alternatives
tickets.text: Review the cash-flow effect of the lock alternatives before Julian responds to the updated loan terms with rate-lock choice and financing contingency timeline.

tickets.title: Resolve student loan payment discrepancy
tickets.text: Resolve the student loan payment discrepancy in the mortgage file, where the application lists Iris's payment as $640 per month while the servicer statement shows a $410 income-driven payment.

tickets.title: Update brokerage aggregation feed
tickets.text: Update the brokerage aggregation feed in the planning portal to reflect current cash and short-term bond positions available for closing, as the feed is showing a stale joint brokerage balance.

tickets.title: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability
tickets.text: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability coverage, as the couple currently has only renters coverage and the purchase changes their property and liability exposure.
tickets.evidence: the agreed new-home insurance and liability coordination is due 2025-10-15

tickets.title: Review tax-lot positions for closing cash
tickets.text: Review tax-lot positions for closing cash, as several taxable ETF positions have both short-term gain lots and lower-gain long-term lots affecting suitability if brokerage assets are used for closing cash.
tickets.evidence: the agreed tax-lot review is due 2025-10-09
